Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019)
Description: The Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CSCC-1:2019) framework was issued by the National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) of Saudi Arabia to establish mandatory cybersecurity controls for Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) and Cloud Service Tenants (CSTs) to securely adopt and manage cloud computing services.

Requirements.Name: CCG-1 Cloud Cybersecurity Governance
Requirements.Description: Cloud computing cybersecurity policies, governance architecture, and compliance oversight must be established and enforced across all subscriptions.

Requirements.Name: CCD-1 Cloud Identity and Access Management
Requirements.Description: Enforce strong Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), role-based access control (RBAC), conditional access, and privileged access boundaries across cloud tenants.

Requirements.Name: CCD-2 Cloud Data & Storage Protection
Requirements.Description: Protect cloud storage, relational databases, NoSQL stores, and data lakes using customer-managed key encryption (CMK), private endpoints, and HTTPS transit enforcement.

Requirements.Name: CCD-3 Cloud Network & Perimeter Defense
Requirements.Description: Cloud virtual networks, subnets, and Kubernetes clusters must be segmented with Network Security Groups (NSGs), firewall rules, and strict ingress/egress filtering.

Requirements.Name: CCD-4 Cloud Cryptographic Key Management
Requirements.Description: Centralize and protect all cryptographic keys, secrets, and certificates in dedicated Key Vaults with purge protection, access logging, and expiration policies.

Requirements.Name: CCD-5 Cloud Threat Detection & Vulnerability Management
Requirements.Description: Continuous threat detection, behavioral anomaly analysis, and workload vulnerability scanning must be enabled across all compute and database layers.

Requirements.Name: CCD-6 Cloud Logging, Auditing & SIEM Ingestion
Requirements.Description: Comprehensive control plane activity logs and diagnostic telemetry must be captured, monitored for anomalous modifications, and archived.

Requirements.Name: CCR-1 Cloud Backup, Recovery & Resilience
Requirements.Description: Implement automated backups, disaster recovery vaults, and soft-delete protections to guarantee business continuity during adverse cyber events.

Requirements.Name: CCT-1 Multi-Tenant Isolation & Third-Party Integrations
Requirements.Description: Enforce strict tenant isolation, guest collaboration restrictions, application registration controls, and third-party risk mitigation.
